name: air-studio-llm

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev:renderer" "npm run dev:electron:build" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 dist-electron/main.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron dist-electron/main.js
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
